entities.name: WEB BROWSER
entities.rationale: Web browser client interface interacting with the web server application.

entities.name: WEB SERVER JOB MANAGER
entities.rationale: Compute instance acting as web server and job manager for orchestrating workloads.

entities.name: DATABASE
entities.rationale: Relational database instance storing application and job metadata.

entities.name: LAMBDA
entities.rationale: AWS Lambda function executing asynchronous processing tasks.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Amazon S3 bucket storing processing artifacts and media files.

entities.name: G3
entities.rationale: G3 GPU-based compute instance executing heavy rendering/simulation workloads.

entities.name: IMF
entities.rationale: Compute node component in the architecture.

visual_connections.description: Bidirectional HTTP/S communication between Web Browser and Web Server Job Manager.
Bidirectional queries and state updates between Web Server Job Manager and Database.
Bidirectional task dispatch and status reporting between Job Manager and Lambda.
Bidirectional read and write operations between Lambda and S3 bucket.
G3 instance uploads processed output and rendering artifacts directly to S3.
